title: When is the convolution a t-norm on normal, convex and upper semicontinuous fuzzy truth values?
summary: In Type-2 rule-based fuzzy systems (T2 RFSs), triangular norms on complete lattice $(\mathbf{L},\sqsubseteq)$ or $(\mathbf{L_u},\sqsubseteq)$ can be used to model the compositional rule of inference, where $\textbf{L}$ is the set of all convex normal fuzzy truth values, $\mathbf{L_u}$ is the set of all convex normal and upper semicontinuous fuzzy truth values, and $\sqsubseteq$ is the so-called convolution order.
